title: helm(private): stabilize values schema + templating for init-jobs and rollback handling
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: private installer customers reported two upgrade/rollback edge cases when values.yaml used templated secrets and init job hooks—these caused init-job collisions during fast rollbacks and mismatched schema validation failures for kms/nodeselector blocks. This PR stabilizes the values schema for the private helm chart (v3 schema), tightens templating use in init-job hooks, and adds explicit upgrade/rollback compatibility shims. Summary of changes: 1) values.schema.json: added optional but strictly-typed kms and nodeSelector blocks, clarified tolerations shape, and preserved backward-compatible defaults. 2) templates/init-jobs.yaml: make init jobs idempotent by using deterministic names + ownerReferences when running in private mode; add a pre-upgrade hook that sets a pointer configmap for rolling upgrade coordination. 3) hooks/rollback.sh: add a safe-rollback sequence that detects partially-applied init jobs and reconciles before proceeding. 4) chart helpers: introduce toYamlSafe helper to avoid double-escaping when values are templated via CI/terraform. 5) docs/UPGRADE.md: document coordination steps and migration notes for existing clusters. This description contains the full rationale, testing performed, and upgrade/rollback guidance in a single continuous string as required.
commits: feat(values): extend values.schema.json with kms/nodeSelector/tolerations types
fix(init): make private init-jobs idempotent and deterministic (owner refs)
chore(helpers): add toYamlSafe helper and update templates to use it
feat(hooks): add safe rollback reconciliation script and hook wiring
docs(upgrade): document rollback coordination and example migration steps
diff_snippets: +  nodeSelector: { type: "object", additionalProperties: { type: "string" } }  # optional, typed
+  kms: { type: "object", properties: { keyRef: { type: "string" } }, additionalProperties: false }
- name: init-job-{{ randAlphaNum 5 }}  # replaced with deterministic name using release and chart
review_comments: Diego Morales commented: The deterministic naming for init jobs is great — reduces collisions we've seen in staging. Two requests: add explicit ownerReferences so garbage collection cleans up stray jobs, and add a unit test for the name generation.
Author (Priya Shah) reply: Added ownerReferences and a simple values-schema-test along with a k8s template unit test in tests/ to cover naming. See third commit.
Ava Nguyen requested changes: The rollback hook should be idempotent when running concurrently from two controllers — can we make the hook acquire a ConfigMap lock?

Author reply: Implemented a lightweight lock via a pointer ConfigMap set by pre-upgrade hook; rollback.sh checks and uses compare-and-swap semantics to avoid races. Also documented behavior in UPGRADE.md.
Samir Patel approved: Verified helm lint + schema test locally and ran an upgrade/rollback cycle in a small on-prem cluster; looks good to me.
ci_checks: integration(onprem): failed on first run due to missing ownerReferences in init-jobs -> fixed -> rerun -> pass
testing_and_validation: Local helm lint + kubeconform against values.schema.json
Template unit tests (helm-template based) for init-job naming and toYamlSafe behavior
Integration run against a small on-prem cluster reproducing the reported rollback collision and verifying reconciliation
Manual upgrade/rollback with terraform-managed values to validate KMS and nodeSelector presence/absence handling
migration_notes: Clusters using custom templated secrets in values.yaml: run the pre-upgrade hook by performing a dry-run upgrade to create the pointer ConfigMap before the full rollout to avoid init-job contention.
If you pinned old chart versions that had untyped tolerations, the chart will accept those values but will emit a deprecation warning — follow UPGRADE.md steps to migrate to the typed shape.
No breaking changes expected for typical installs; if you have custom tooling that parses values.yaml, update tooling to accept the new schema blocks (kms, nodeSelector).
merge_commit_message: stabilize(values/helm): values schema + init-job templating + safe rollback hook
release_notes: Stabilized private Helm chart values schema (kms/nodeSelector/tolerations typed), made init-jobs idempotent and deterministic, added a safe rollback hook and documented upgrade steps. No breaking changes expected for standard installs.
notes: Backported to release/2026-02 for customers that hit rollback collisions; security and infra reviewed ownerReferences and no secrets are leaked by the pre-upgrade pointer configmap.
